MINUTES
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING
  DECEMBER 17, 2025

  1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

  A special meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills
  Estates was called to order at 7:01 p.m. at City of Rolling Hills Estates Council Chamber,
  4045 Palos Verdes Drive N, Rolling Hills Estates, California, by CHAIR PERSICHINA.

  2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

  CHAIR PERSICHINA led those present in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Persichina, Pope, Johnson, Holdsworth, and
  Bain

  Commissioners Absent:  Ciarolla and McCormick

  City Staff Present:  Maintenance Superintendent Mike Goldsmith
  Community Services Supervisor Rosa Pinuelas
  Community Services Coordinator Matt Morrow

  4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  PARK & ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING DRAFT MINUTES OF
  OCTOBER 21, 2025

  COMMISSIONER BAIN made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER
  HOLDSWORTH to:

  APPROVE THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MINUTES OF
  OCTOBER 21, 2025.

  There being no objection, CHAIR PERSICHINA so ordered.

  5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA

  NONE.

  6.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  PROPOSED 2026 SILVER SPUR LITTLE LEAGUE AGREEMENT

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  1
DECEMBER 17, 2025
   Supervisor Pinuelas gave an overview of the proposed 2026 agreement with Silver
  Spur Little League (as per the agenda material).

  CHAIR PERSICHINA thanked Staff for their work drafting this year’s agreement.

  In response to COMMISSIONER BAIN, Supervisor Pinuelas stated that the 2026
  field usage costs for Ernie Howlett Park Fields A, B & C listed in the agreement
  were also charged in 2025 and based on the combined cost of the standard use
  fees charged to Silver Spur Little League for Ernie Howlett Park Fields A & B and
  the standard use fee charged for Peninsula Junior League’s use of Field C under
  the 2024 Fees and Charges Schedule.

  In response to COMMISSIONER BAIN, Maintenance Superintendent Goldsmith
  stated that Silver Spur Little League is responsible for field maintenance during the
  in-season use of the fields and generally performs this responsibility to an
  acceptable standard.

  COMMISSIONER  HOLDSWORTH  made  a  motion,  seconded  by
  COMMISSIONER BAIN to:

  RECOMMEND THE CITY COUNCIL APPROVE THE 2026 AGREEMENT
  WITH SILVER SPUR LITTLE LEAGUE FOR USE OF ERNIE HOWLETT
  PARK’S SPORTS FIELDS.

  AYES:  Johnson, Holdsworth, Bain, Pope, and Persichina
  ABSENT:  Ciarolla and McCormick

  B.  COMMITTEE, SUBCOMMITTEE, AND ADOPT-A-PARK ASSIGNMENTS

  Supervisor Pinuelas gave a brief overview of the current Committee,
  Subcommittee, and Adopt-A-Park assignments (as per the agenda material).

  The Commission discussed the assignments and came to a consensus regarding
  the overall Committee, Subcommittee, Adopt-A-Park assignments for the 2026
  calendar year.

  C.  2026 COUNCIL MEETING ATTENDANCE SCHEDULE

  Supervisor Pinuelas gave a brief overview of the 2026 Council Meeting Attendance
  Schedule (as per the agenda material).

  In response to COMMISSIONER BAIN, Supervisor Pinuelas noted that
  Commissioners are not required to be present at their scheduled City Council
  meeting and do not need to arrange a replacement if last-minute circumstances
  prevent attendance.

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  2
DECEMBER 17, 2025
   The Commission reviewed the proposed schedule assignments; no adjustments
  were made.

  D.  2025 PENINSULA PARADE OF LIGHTS DEBRIEF (VERBAL REPORT)

  Coordinator Morrow provided a brief overview of the 2025 Peninsula Parade of
  Lights that was held on Saturday, December 6. He gave an overview of the final
  parade line-up highlighting select parade units, the pre-parade VIP reception,
  sponsorships, and the overall success of the event.

  COMMISSIONER BAIN thanked Staff on another wonderful parade.

  VICE CHAIR POPE also thanked Staff for all their efforts and putting on a great
  parade.

  VICE CHAIR POPE inquired about a segment of the parade route along Roxcove
  Drive to Deep Valley Drive that appeared to be insufficiently lit and whether that
  may have caused a gap in parade attendees along that portion of the route. She
  also suggested reaching out to the local businesses in that location to assess
  interest in installing festive lighting or using existing business lighting to create
  more of a festive environment. Superintendent Goldsmith stated that the addition
  of lighting along the parade route has been discussed and that this section has
  been identified as a potential location for additional lighting.

  E.  2025 CITY CELEBRATION DEBRIEF

  Coordinator Morrow provided a brief overview of the City Celebration Debrief
  report (as per the agenda material).

  VICE CHAIR POPE commended Staff on a wonderful job with the City Celebration
  event.

  COMMISSIONER BAIN also commended Staff on a wonderful job done handling
  the event’s last-minute location change logistics. She also discussed the activities
  costs for future event attendees and expressed her preference for holding the 2026
  event at Ernie Howlett Park.

  A discussion ensued regarding the location of the 2026 event and future events,
  regarding whether to hold the event at Ernie Howlett Park or the Empty Saddle
  Club, as well as the date for the 2026 event.

  VICE CHAIR POPE made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER JOHNSON
  to:

  RECEIVE AND FILE THIS REPORT.

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  3
DECEMBER 17, 2025
   There being no objection, CHAIR PERSICHINA so ordered.

  **ADJOURNED TO PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION ADVISORY BOARD MEETING AT
  7:35 PM**

  F.  2025 TRACY AUSTIN DOUBLES TENNIS TOURNAMENT DEBRIEF

  Coordinator Morrow provided a brief overview of the Tracy Austin Doubles Tennis
  Tournament Debrief report (as per the agenda material).

  COMMISSIONER BAIN made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER
  HOLDSWORTH to:

  RECEIVE AND FILE THIS REPORT.

  There being no objection, CHAIR PERSICHINA so ordered.

  **RECONVENED PARKS AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING AT 7:38 PM**

  7.  STAFF ITEMS

  A.  2026 PROPOSED EVENT SCHEDULE

  Supervisor Pinuelas provided a brief overview of the proposed 2026 special event
  schedule (as per the attached agenda material).

  In response to COMMISSIONER BAIN, Supervisor Pinuelas stated that the
  number of City events proposed for 2026 is the same as 2025; however, several
  non-City events were removed from the proposed 2026 schedule as they did not
  occur in 2025. She further stated that the City is at capacity with City special events
  and would need to consider removing an existing event in order to add an
  additional City event.

  In response to VICE CHAIR POPE, Supervisor Pinuelas stated that Kids to Parks
  Day is a nationally recognized day that occurs on the third Saturday in May as an
  incentive for families to come out to the parks.

  CHAIR PERSICHINA made a motion, seconded by VICE CHAIR POPE to:

  RECEIVE AND FILE THIS REPORT.

  There being no objection, CHAIR PERSICHINA so ordered.

  B.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE.

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  4
DECEMBER 17, 2025
   8.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  A.  ADOPT-A-PARK (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE.

  B.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE

  9.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF OCTOBER 14, 2025

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

  B.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF OCTOBER 28, 2025

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

  C.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF NOVEMBER 18, 2025

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

  10.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR PERSICHINA ADJOURNED THE MEETING AT 7:46 PM TO THE NEXT
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING ON JANUARY 20, 2026, AT
  7:00 P.M., WHICH WILL BE HELD IN THE CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CITY
  HALL .

  There being no objection, so ordered.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

  ___________________________  ___________________________
  Matt Morrow  Lou Persichina
  Community Services Coordinator  Chair, Park & Activities Commission

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  5
DECEMBER 17, 2025
